passkey-disclaimer-p1: Please read this disclaimer carefully before using Passkey, and make sure you fully understand its content and legal implications. By clicking Agree to enable Passkey, you accept this disclaimer.
passkey-disclaimer-p2: Passkeys can be used to sign in to your EasiCoin account and confirm withdrawals, transfers, and other sensitive actions. Your private key is stored securely on your device (phone, computer, or hardware security key) and is never uploaded to EasiCoin's servers or sent over the network. You can verify with your passkey using your device's biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint, facial unlock), screen lock passcode, pattern, or a hardware security key.
passkey-disclaimer-p3: Cross-device passkeys (such as those synced via iCloud Keychain or Google Password Manager) rely on your iCloud account, Google account, and your device's underlying system capabilities. Your passkey may sync automatically across devices within the same operating system ecosystem via your iCloud or Google account. You should fully understand the security risks this syncing may introduce. If your iCloud or Google account is compromised and an attacker is able to bypass your device's unlock verification (including but not limited to Face ID, facial unlock, Touch ID, fingerprint, pattern, or screen lock passcode), they may be able to use your passkey to complete identity verification. You bear full responsibility for any resulting losses or legal consequences, including but not limited to unauthorized account access, asset transfers, or information leaks.
passkey-disclaimer-p4: You are responsible for safeguarding any device with an enabled passkey. If a device is lost or stolen, remove its passkey access immediately via EasiCoin's Security Center or other available means. You bear full responsibility for any losses or legal consequences resulting from a lost or stolen device if you fail to promptly remove the associated passkey access.
passkey-disclaimer-p5: EasiCoin will take reasonable technical measures to keep Passkey secure and stable, but cannot guarantee it will work properly in every environment or on every device. To the fullest extent permitted by law, EasiCoin is not liable for any direct, indirect, incidental, or consequential losses arising from your use of cross-device passkeys, a lost or stolen device, a compromised iCloud/Google account, or exposure of your device's unlock method.
passkey-disclaimer-p6: Safeguard your iCloud account, Google account, and device unlock methods (including but not limited to biometric data and screen lock passcodes). Regularly review your enabled passkeys and remove devices you no longer use or trust.
passkey-disclaimer-p7: If you notice any unauthorized use of your passkey, contact EasiCoin Support immediately.
